::: {#exr-dummy-coding}
#### Dummy coding

The WCGS variable `behpat` (behavioral pattern) has four categories:
A1, A2, B3, and B4.

(a) How many indicator variables are needed to represent `behpat`
if A1 is the reference level?
(b) Write the values of those indicator variables,
in the order A2, B3, B4,
for a person in category B3,
and for a person in category A1.
:::
